protocol.admission: Every plain and selected source/mode must agree on typed inventory, literal edited-owner Rust argv, physical native roster, full old/new/unchanged native outputs and actual verdicts. Each selected new/unchanged/repair must match complete independently empty new ELF. Retain known Wild nondeterminism or any other difference as a failed gate. No substitution, outlier deletion or rerun on effects.
protocol.ownership: All real rustc --crate-name invocations use identical immutable loader, plugin and argv on both diagnostic arms. Scope is all signed Rust compilations, including dependencies. The receiver charges physical C wrapper, stderr relay, DSO loading and logging; empty-root and diagnostic flanks and independent client/tests are saved separately.
protocol.programs: All roles use package ports from signed -22. No Rust/Cargo replacement, RUSTFLAGS, custom-profile flag, trust override, global preload, shared target or warm target injection. LD_PRELOAD is scoped to one exec of physical rustc, cleared before Rust main; exact signed LLVM/driver and strict outputs required.
protocol.limits: No real Ruff promotion on absent hardware counter, altered old/new source, changed dirty roster or native bytes, or zero proved omissions in a changed owner. Per-thread guard diagnostic text may interleave; report complete anchored rows only, without imputation.
